ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 6:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white field across both fluke lobes; high-contrast black perimeter along the trailing edge; vertical black banding/striations at the central peduncle-fluke junction; scattered small low-intensity circular spots (mottling) across the white surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 12 percent of visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the continuous trailing edge boundary, with pixel-amplitudes of variations ranging from 5 to 20 pixels, most aggressive at distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave sweep from the central notch curving upward towards the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity, roughly circular calcified pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated at both distal tips; numerous tan/grey circular focal spots across the central white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of dark, vertically-aligned linear pixel disruptions at the central base; several faint diagonal scratches on the right fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle colonization at the extreme left and right trailing edges; multiple circular scars across the ventral surface likely from previous barnacle attachments or parasitic lesions.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive horizontal 'ladder-like' black pigmentation rungs located at the vertical center where the fluke meets the peduncle.
